frozen_original.title: Trump Says He Will Not Accept 2028 Election Results If He Loses
frozen_original.synopsis: In September 2025, during interviews and rally appearances, Trump stated that he would not commit to accepting the results of the 2028 presidential election if he were to lose, continuing a pattern of preemptively refusing to commit to democratic transitions of power that he established before both the 2016 and 2020 elections. The refusal to commit to peaceful transfer of power was seen as particularly alarming given Trump's actions following the 2020 election and the January 6 Capitol attack. The statements also raised questions about Trump's intent regarding the 22nd Amendment and potential third-term ambitions.

frozen_original.title: RFK Jr. Promotes Raw Milk Despite Active Salmonella Outbreaks
frozen_original.synopsis: In April 2025, HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. publicly promoted the consumption of raw (unpasteurized) milk while the CDC and FDA were actively investigating multistate salmonella and E. coli outbreaks linked to raw dairy products. Kennedy posted on social media encouraging Americans to drink raw milk, claiming pasteurization destroys beneficial nutrients — a claim not supported by scientific evidence. The FDA, which regulates interstate raw milk sales, was simultaneously warning consumers to avoid the product. Pasture-raised raw milk had been implicated in a H5N1 bird flu transmission in dairy cattle, raising concerns about human exposure. Public health experts called Kennedy's endorsement reckless and said it could encourage raw milk consumption during an active outbreak, increasing hospitalizations and potential deaths.

frozen_original.synopsis: A Harvard Law student was detained at a US airport and subjected to extended questioning by DHS agents over social media posts criticizing US foreign policy, in a blatant act of political targeting.
